title: Python / Colab Run Order

canonical_node.axiom: Runtime artifacts must be classified and gated before public use; unresolved or mixed artifacts must not be cited as verified.
definitions: open_or_conflicted: artifact has unresolved contradiction; treat as objection/repair page.
mixed_verified_and_open: artifact contains both verified results and unresolved notes; must split before citing.
not_declared: artifact has no evidence classification; must be manually classified and assigned an evidence rung.
claims_verified: artifact's claims are verified; still requires rerun and output hash capture.
Phase 1: fast local checks; Phase 2: runtime/JAX checks; Phase 3: data/network/colab path checks.
derivation: The document lists artifacts with statuses and required actions before public use.
Artifacts with status 'open_or_conflicted' must be treated as objection/repair pages until contradiction resolved.
Artifacts with status 'mixed_verified_and_open' must split verified results from unresolved notes before citing.
Artifacts with status 'not_declared' must be manually classified and assigned an evidence rung.
Artifacts with status 'claims_verified' must be rerun later, capture output hash, and link to exact public claim.
Phase 1 is the first safe batch because it is least likely to fail due to missing data, network assumptions, or runtime configuration.
canonical_node.action: Execute Phase 1 first; for each artifact, apply the required action based on its status before any public use or citation.
boundary: Does not execute any artifact; it only defines run order and gating.
Does not resolve contradictions or classify artifacts; it mandates that those actions occur.
Does not claim any artifact is verified; it only records statuses and required actions.
test: Check that Phase 1 artifacts are run before Phase 2 and Phase 3.
Check that each artifact with status 'open_or_conflicted' is treated as objection/repair page.
Check that each artifact with status 'mixed_verified_and_open' has split verified and open notes before citation.
Check that each artifact with status 'not_declared' has been manually classified and assigned an evidence rung.
Check that each artifact with status 'claims_verified' has been rerun, output hash captured, and linked to exact public claim.

dg1_dependencies: Artifact statuses as recorded in the document
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a gating protocol for runtime artifacts, ensuring unresolved or mixed artifacts are not cited as verified.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the requirement that artifacts must be classified and gated before public use; does not alter any underlying claims.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this run order, artifacts could be cited prematurely without proper classification or gating, leading to unverified claims being treated as verified.
dg5_translation_registers: mixed_verified_and_open -> split verified and open notes
not_declared -> manual classification and evidence rung
claims_verified -> rerun, output hash, link to public claim

overstatement_risks: Might be interpreted as evidence that artifacts are verified when they are not.
Might be interpreted as a claim that Phase 1 artifacts are safe to cite, when they still require gating.
kill_conditions: If any artifact with status 'open_or_conflicted' is cited as verified without resolution.
If any artifact with status 'mixed_verified_and_open' is cited without splitting verified and open notes.
If any artifact with status 'not_declared' is cited without classification and evidence rung.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the gating conditions as preconditions for citation.

plain_summary: This document defines a run order for Python/Colab artifacts, assigning each a status and required action before public use. It is a procedural guardrail, not a proof of any physical claim.
